correctness.rationale: The full labelled synchronous rule factors exactly through eight capped opposite-shore counts and eight initial-colour tags. Each of the 6400 possible nonempty initial capped signatures is realizable; the supplied standard-library program exhausts every signature, checks F^17=F^5, identifies the 20 six-basin signatures and verifies the five-step sharp witness. An independent vertex-level simulator checks direct full states; multinomial weighting of the 20 signatures proves N6 and 4U_mU_n on-cycle points. The code is an exhaustive finite certificate, not an extrapolation from finite graph sizes. No conclusion is asserted for other models.

value.rationale: The exact 20-signature classification distinguishes four new-colour transient and periodic mechanisms. For every K_{m,n}, it gives a sharp uniform entry time, exact six-cycle existence boundary m,n>=6, one-step-only feeders to six-cycles, exact labelled basin counts and primitive orbit counts, and a nontrivial exponentially small balanced-size basin asymptotic. This resolves a motivated nonlinear finite-dynamical basin enumeration, beyond a simple existence witness.
